text_en: Aleph. How does the city sit solitary that was full of people! how is the mistress of the Gentiles become as a widow : the princes of provinces made tributary!
text_la: Aleph. Quomodo sedet sola civitas plena populo! Facta est quasi vidua domina gentium; princeps provinciarum facta est sub tributo.
text_pt: Visão de Obadias: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS a respeito de Edom: Temos ouvido a pregação do SENHOR, e foi enviado aos gentios um emissário, dizendo: Levantai-vos, e levantemo-nos contra ela para a guerra.
text_el: πῶς ἐκάθισεν μόνη ἡ πόλις ἡ πεπληθυμμένη λαῶν ἐγενήθη ὡς χήρα πεπληθυμμένη ἐν ἔθνεσιν ἄρχουσα ἐν χώραις ἐγενήθη εἰς φόρον

text_en: Beth. Weeping, she has wept in the night, and her tears are on her cheeks: there is none to comfort her among all them that were dear to her: all her friends have despised her, and have become her enemies.
text_la: Beth. Plorans ploravit in nocte, et lacrimæ ejus in maxillis ejus : non est qui consoletur eam, ex omnibus caris ejus; omnes amici ejus spreverunt eam, et facti sunt ei inimici.
text_pt: Eis que te fiz pequeno entre os gentios; tu és muito desprezado.
text_el: κλαίουσα ἔκλαυσεν ἐν νυκτί καὶ τὰ δάκρυα αὐτῆς ἐπὶ τῶν σιαγόνων αὐτῆς καὶ οὐχ ὑπάρχει ὁ παρακαλῶν αὐτὴν ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν ἀγαπώντων αὐτήν πάντες οἱ φιλοῦντες αὐτὴν ἠθέτησαν ἐν αὐτῇ ἐγένοντο αὐτῇ εἰς ἐχθρούς

text_en: Ghimel. Juda has removed her dwelling place, because of her affliction, and the greatness of her bondage; she has dwelt among the nations, and she has found no rest; all her persecutors have taken her in the midst of straits.
text_la: Ghimel. Migravit Judas propter afflictionem, et multitudinem servitutis; habitavit inter gentes, nec invenit requiem : omnes persecutores ejus apprehenderunt eam inter angustias.
text_pt: A soberba do teu coração te enganou, como o que habita nas fendas das rochas, na sua alta morada, que diz no seu coração: Quem me derrubará em terra?
text_el: μετῳκίσθη ἡ Ιουδαία ἀπὸ ταπεινώσεως αὐτῆς καὶ ἀπὸ πλήθους δουλείας αὐτῆς ἐκάθισεν ἐν ἔθνεσιν οὐχ εὗρεν ἀνάπαυσιν πάντες οἱ καταδιώκοντες αὐτὴν κατέλαβον αὐτὴν ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν θλιβόντων

text_en: Daleth. The ways of Sion mourn, because there are none that come to the solemn feast: all her gates are broken down; her priests sigh; her virgins are in affliction; and she is oppressed with bitterness.
text_la: Daleth. Viæ Sion lugent, eo quod non sint qui veniant ad solemnitatem : omnes portæ ejus destructæ, sacerdotes ejus gementes; virgines ejus squalidæ, et ipsa oppressa amaritudine.
text_pt: Se te elevares como águia, e puseres o teu ninho entre as estrelas, dali te derrubarei, diz o Senhor.
text_el: ὁδοὶ Σιων πενθοῦσιν παρὰ τὸ μὴ εἶναι ἐρχομένους ἐν ἑορτῇ πᾶσαι αἱ πύλαι αὐτῆς ἠφανισμέναι οἱ ἱερεῖς αὐτῆς ἀναστενάζουσιν αἱ παρθένοι αὐτῆς ἀγόμεναι καὶ αὐτὴ πικραινομένη ἐν ἑαυτῇ

text_en: He. Her adversaries have become her lords; her enemies are enriched; because the Lord has spoken against her for the multitude of her iniquities ; her children are led into captivity, before the face of the oppressor.
text_la: He. Facti sunt hostes ejus in capite; inimici ejus locupletati sunt : quia Dominus locutus est super eam propter multitudinem iniquitatum ejus. Parvuli ejus ducti sunt in captivitatem ante faciem tribulantis.
text_pt: Se viessem a ti ladrões, ou assaltantes de noite (como estás destruído! ), não furtariam o que lhes bastasse? Se a ti viessem os vindimadores, não deixariam algumas uvas?
text_el: ἐγένοντο οἱ θλίβοντες αὐτὴν εἰς κεφαλήν καὶ οἱ ἐχθροὶ αὐτῆς εὐθηνοῦσαν ὅτι κύριος ἐταπείνωσεν αὐτὴν ἐπὶ τὸ πλῆθος τῶν ἀσεβειῶν αὐτῆς τὰ νήπια αὐτῆς ἐπορεύθησαν ἐν αἰχμαλωσίᾳ κατὰ πρόσωπον θλίβοντος

text_en: Vau. And from the daughter of Sion, all her beauty is departed; her princes have become like rams that find no pastures; and they have gone away without strength before the face of the pursuer.
text_la: Vau. Et egressus est a filia Sion omnis decor ejus; facti sunt principes ejus velut arietes non invenientes pascua, et abierunt absque fortitudine ante faciem subsequentis.
text_pt: Como foram rebuscados os bens de Esaú! Como foram investigados os seus tesouros escondidos!
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἐκ θυγατρὸς Σιων πᾶσα ἡ εὐπρέπεια αὐτῆς ἐγένοντο οἱ ἄρχοντες αὐτῆς ὡς κριοὶ οὐχ εὑρίσκοντες νομὴν καὶ ἐπορεύοντο ἐν οὐκ ἰσχύι κατὰ πρόσωπον διώκοντος

text_en: Zain. Jerusalem has remembered the days of her affliction, and prevarication of all her desirable things which she had from the days of old, when her people fell in the enemy's hand, and there was no helper; the enemies have seen her, and have mocked at her sabbaths .
text_la: Zain. Recordata est Jerusalem dierum afflictionis suæ, et prævaricationis, omnium desiderabilium suorum, quæ habuerat a diebus antiquis, cum caderet populus ejus in manu hostili, et non esset auxiliator : viderunt eam hostes, et deriserunt sabbata ejus.
text_pt: Todos os teus confederados te levaram até a fronteira; os que gozam da tua paz te enganaram, prevaleceram contra ti; os que comem o teu pão puseram debaixo de ti uma armadilha; não há nele entendimento.
text_el: ἐμνήσθη Ιερουσαλημ ἡμερῶν ταπεινώσεως αὐτῆς καὶ ἀπωσμῶν αὐτῆς πάντα τὰ ἐπιθυμήματα αὐτῆς ὅσα ἦν ἐξ ἡμερῶν ἀρχαίων ἐν τῷ πεσεῖν τὸν λαὸν αὐτῆς εἰς χεῖρας θλίβοντος καὶ οὐκ ἦν ὁ βοηθῶν αὐτῇ ἰδόντες οἱ ἐχθροὶ αὐτῆς ἐγέλασαν ἐπὶ μετοικεσίᾳ αὐτῆς

text_en: Heth. Jerusalem has grievously sinned , therefore is she become unstable; all that honoured her, have despised her, because they have seen her shame; but she sighed, and turned backward.
text_la: Heth. Peccatum peccavit Jerusalem, propterea instabilis facta est; omnes qui glorificabant eam spreverunt illam, quia viderunt ignominiam ejus : ipsa autem gemens conversa est retrorsum.
text_pt: Porventura não acontecerá naquele dia, diz o Senhor, que farei perecer os sábios de Edom, e o entendimento do monte de Esaú?
text_el: ἁμαρτίαν ἥμαρτεν Ιερουσαλημ διὰ τοῦτο εἰς σάλον ἐγένετο πάντες οἱ δοξάζοντες αὐτὴν ἐταπείνωσαν αὐτήν εἶδον γὰρ τὴν ἀσχημοσύνην αὐτῆς καί γε αὐτὴ στενάζουσα καὶ ἀπεστράφη ὀπίσω

text_en: Teth. Her filthiness is on her feet, and she has not remembered her end; she is wonderfully cast down, not having a comforter: behold, O Lord , my affliction, because the enemy is lifted up.
text_la: Teth. Sordes ejus in pedibus ejus, nec recordata est finis sui; deposita est vehementer, non habens consolatorem. Vide, Domine, afflictionem meam, quoniam erectus est inimicus.
text_pt: E os teus poderosos, ó Temã, estarão atemorizados, para que do monte de Esaú seja cada um exterminado pela matança.
text_el: ἀκαθαρσία αὐτῆς πρὸς ποδῶν αὐτῆς οὐκ ἐμνήσθη ἔσχατα αὐτῆς καὶ κατεβίβασεν ὑπέρογκα οὐκ ἔστιν ὁ παρακαλῶν αὐτήν ἰδέ κύριε τὴν ταπείνωσίν μου ὅτι ἐμεγαλύνθη ἐχθρός

text_en: Jod. The enemy has put out his hand to all her desirable things: for she has seen the Gentiles enter into her sanctuary, of whom you gave commandment that they should not enter into your church.
text_la: Jod. Manum suam misit hostis ad omnia desiderabilia ejus, quia vidit gentes ingressas sanctuarium suum, de quibus præceperas ne intrarent in ecclesiam tuam.
text_pt: Por causa da violência feita a teu irmão Jacó, cobrir-te-á a confusão, e serás exterminado para sempre.
text_el: χεῖρα αὐτοῦ ἐξεπέτασεν θλίβων ἐπὶ πάντα τὰ ἐπιθυμήματα αὐτῆς εἶδεν γὰρ ἔθνη εἰσελθόντα εἰς τὸ ἁγίασμα αὐτῆς ἃ ἐνετείλω μὴ εἰσελθεῖν αὐτὰ εἰς ἐκκλησίαν σου

text_en: Caph. All her people sigh, they seek bread: they have given all their precious things for food to relieve the soul : see, O Lord , and consider, for I have become vile.
text_la: Caph. Omnis populus ejus gemens, et quærens panem; dederunt pretiosa quæque pro cibo ad refocillandam animam. Vide, Domine, et considera quoniam facta sum vilis!
text_pt: No dia em que o confrontaste, no dia em que estranhos levaram cativo o seu exército, e os estrangeiros entravam pelas suas portas, e lançaram sortes sobre Jerusalém, tu eras também como um deles.
text_el: πᾶς ὁ λαὸς αὐτῆς καταστενάζοντες ζητοῦντες ἄρτον ἔδωκαν τὰ ἐπιθυμήματα αὐτῆς ἐν βρώσει τοῦ ἐπιστρέψαι ψυχήν ἰδέ κύριε καὶ ἐπίβλεψον ὅτι ἐγενήθην ἠτιμωμένη

text_en: Lamed. O all you that pass by the way, attend, and see if there be any sorrow like to my sorrow: for he has made a vintage of me, as the Lord spoke in the day of his fierce anger .
text_la: Lamed. O vos omnes qui transitis per viam, attendite, et videte si est dolor sicut dolor meus! quoniam vindemiavit me, ut locutus est Dominus, in die iræ furoris sui.
text_pt: Mas tu não devias olhar com prazer para o dia de teu irmão, no dia do seu infortúnio; nem alegrar-te sobre os filhos de Judá, no dia da sua ruína; nem alargar a tua boca, no dia da angústia;
text_el: οὐ πρὸς ὑμᾶς πάντες οἱ παραπορευόμενοι ὁδόν ἐπιστρέψατε καὶ ἴδετε εἰ ἔστιν ἄλγος κατὰ τὸ ἄλγος μου ὃ ἐγενήθη φθεγξάμενος ἐν ἐμοὶ ἐταπείνωσέν με κύριος ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ὀργῆς θυμοῦ αὐτοῦ

text_en: Mem. From above he has sent fire into my bones, and has chastised me: he has spread a net for my feet, he has turned me back: he has made me desolate, wasted with sorrow all the day long.
text_la: Mem. De excelso misit ignem in ossibus meis, et erudivit me : expandit rete pedibus meis, convertit me retrorsum; posuit me desolatam, tota die mœrore confectam.
text_pt: Nem entrar pela porta do meu povo, no dia da sua calamidade; sim, tu não devias olhar satisfeito o seu mal, no dia da sua calamidade; nem lançar mão dos seus bens, no dia da sua calamidade;
text_el: ἐξ ὕψους αὐτοῦ ἀπέστειλεν πῦρ ἐν τοῖς ὀστέοις μου κατήγαγεν αὐτό διεπέτασεν δίκτυον τοῖς ποσίν μου ἀπέστρεψέν με εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω ἔδωκέν με ἠφανισμένην ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν ὀδυνωμένην

text_en: Nun. The yoke of my iniquities has watched: they are folded together in his hand, and put upon my neck: my strength is weakened: the Lord has delivered me into a hand, out of which I am not able to rise.
text_la: Nun. Vigilavit jugum iniquitatum mearum; in manu ejus convolutæ sunt, et impositæ collo meo. Infirmata est virtus mea : dedit me Dominus in manu de qua non potero surgere.
text_pt: Nem parar nas encruzilhadas, para exterminares os que escapassem; nem entregar os que lhe restassem, no dia da angústia.
text_el: ἐγρηγορήθη ἐπὶ τὰ ἀσεβήματά μου ἐν χερσίν μου συνεπλάκησαν ἀνέβησαν ἐπὶ τὸν τράχηλόν μου ἠσθένησεν ἡ ἰσχύς μου ὅτι ἔδωκεν κύριος ἐν χερσίν μου ὀδύνας οὐ δυνήσομαι στῆναι

text_en: Samech. The Lord has taken away all my mighty men out of the midst of me: he has called against me the time, to destroy my chosen men : the Lord has trodden the winepress for the virgin daughter of Juda .
text_la: Samech. Abstulit omnes magnificos meos Dominus de medio mei; vocavit adversum me tempus ut contereret electos meos. Torcular calcavit Dominus virgini filiæ Juda.
text_pt: Porque o dia do Senhor está perto, sobre todos os gentios; como tu fizeste, assim se fará contigo; a tua recompensa voltará sobre a tua cabeça.
text_el: ἐξῆρεν πάντας τοὺς ἰσχυρούς μου ὁ κύριος ἐκ μέσου μου ἐκάλεσεν ἐπ' ἐμὲ καιρὸν τοῦ συντρῖψαι ἐκλεκτούς μου ληνὸν ἐπάτησεν κύριος παρθένῳ θυγατρὶ Ιουδα ἐπὶ τούτοις ἐγὼ κλαίω

text_en: Ain. Therefore do I weep, and my eyes run down with water: because the comforter, the relief of my soul , is far from me: my children are desolate because the enemy has prevailed.
text_la: Ain. Idcirco ego plorans, et oculus meus deducens aquas, quia longe factus est a me consolator, convertens animam meam. Facti sunt filii mei perditi, quoniam invaluit inimicus.
text_pt: Porque, como vós bebestes no meu santo monte, assim beberão também de contínuo todos os gentios; beberão, e sorverão, e serão como se nunca tivessem sido.
text_el: ὁ ὀφθαλμός μου κατήγαγεν ὕδωρ ὅτι ἐμακρύνθη ἀπ' ἐμοῦ ὁ παρακαλῶν με ὁ ἐπιστρέφων ψυχήν μου ἐγένοντο οἱ υἱοί μου ἠφανισμένοι ὅτι ἐκραταιώθη ὁ ἐχθρός

text_en: Phe. Sion has spread forth her hands, there is none to comfort her: the Lord has commanded against Jacob , his enemies are round about him: Jerusalem is as a menstruous woman among them.
text_la: Phe. Expandit Sion manus suas; non est qui consoletur eam. Mandavit Dominus adversum Jacob in circuitu ejus hostes ejus; facta est Jerusalem quasi polluta menstruis inter eos.
text_pt: Mas no monte Sião haverá livramento, e ele será santo; e os da casa de Jacó possuirão as suas herdades.
text_el: διεπέτασεν Σιων χεῖρας αὐτῆς οὐκ ἔστιν ὁ παρακαλῶν αὐτήν ἐνετείλατο κύριος τῷ Ιακωβ κύκλῳ αὐτοῦ οἱ θλίβοντες αὐτόν ἐγενήθη Ιερουσαλημ εἰς ἀποκαθημένην ἀνὰ μέσον αὐτῶν

text_en: Sade. The Lord is just , for I have provoked his mouth to wrath : hear, I pray you, all you people, and see my sorrow: my virgins , and my young men have gone into captivity.
text_la: Sade. Justus est Dominus, quia os ejus ad iracundiam provocavi. Audite, obsecro, universi populi, et videte dolorem meum : virgines meæ et juvenes mei abierunt in captivitatem.
text_pt: E a casa de Jacó será fogo, e a casa de José uma chama, e a casa de Esaú palha; e se acenderão contra eles, e os consumirão; e ninguém mais restará da casa de Esaú, porque o Senhor o falou.
text_el: δίκαιός ἐστιν κύριος ὅτι τὸ στόμα αὐτοῦ παρεπίκρανα ἀκούσατε δή πάντες οἱ λαοί καὶ ἴδετε τὸ ἄλγος μου παρθένοι μου καὶ νεανίσκοι μου ἐπορεύθησαν ἐν αἰχμαλωσίᾳ

text_en: Coph. I called for my friends, but they deceived me: my priests and my ancients pined away in the city: while they sought their food, to relieve their souls .
text_la: Coph. Vocavi amicos meos, et ipsi deceperunt me; sacerdotes mei et senes mei in urbe consumpti sunt, quia quæsierunt cibum sibi ut refocillarent animam suam.
text_pt: E os do sul possuirão o monte de Esaú, e os das planícies, os filisteus; possuirão também os campos de Efraim, e os campos de Samaria; e Benjamim possuirá a Gileade.
text_el: ἐκάλεσα τοὺς ἐραστάς μου αὐτοὶ δὲ παρελογίσαντό με οἱ ἱερεῖς μου καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροί μου ἐν τῇ πόλει ἐξέλιπον ὅτι ἐζήτησαν βρῶσιν αὐτοῖς ἵνα ἐπιστρέψωσιν ψυχὰς αὐτῶν καὶ οὐχ εὗρον

text_en: Res. Behold, O Lord , for I am in distress, my bowels are troubled: my heart is turned within me, for I am full of bitterness: abroad the sword destroys and at home there is death alike.
text_la: Res. Vide, Domine, quoniam tribulor : conturbatus est venter meus, subversum est cor meum in memetipsa, quoniam amaritudine plena sum. Foris interfecit gladius, et domi mors similis est.
text_pt: E os cativos deste exército, dos filhos de Israel, possuirão os cananeus, até Zarefate; e os cativos de Jerusalém, que estão em Sefarade, possuirão as cidades do sul.
text_el: ἰδέ κύριε ὅτι θλίβομαι ἡ κοιλία μου ἐταράχθη καὶ ἡ καρδία μου ἐστράφη ἐν ἐμοί ὅτι παραπικραίνουσα παρεπίκρανα ἔξωθεν ἠτέκνωσέν με μάχαιρα ὥσπερ θάνατος ἐν οἴκῳ

text_en: Sin. They have heard that I sigh, and there is none to comfort me: all my enemies have heard of my evil , they have rejoiced that you have done it: you have brought a day of consolation, and they shall be like unto me.
text_la: Sin. Audierunt quia ingemisco ego, et non est qui consoletur me; omnes inimici mei audierunt malum meum, lætati sunt quoniam tu fecisti : adduxisti diem consolationis, et fient similes mei.
text_pt: E subirão salvadores ao monte Sião, para julgarem o monte de Esaú; e o reino será do Senhor.
text_el: ἀκούσατε δὴ ὅτι στενάζω ἐγώ οὐκ ἔστιν ὁ παρακαλῶν με πάντες οἱ ἐχθροί μου ἤκουσαν τὰ κακά μου καὶ ἐχάρησαν ὅτι σὺ ἐποίησας ἐπήγαγες ἡμέραν ἐκάλεσας καιρόν καὶ ἐγένοντο ὅμοιοι ἐμοί

text_en: Thau. Let all their evil be present before you: and make vintage of them, as you have made vintage of me for all my iniquities : for my sighs are many, and my heart is sorrowful.
text_la: Thau. Ingrediatur omne malum eorum coram te : et vindemia eos, sicut vindemiasti me propter omnes iniquitates meas : multi enim gemitus mei, et cor meum mœrens.
text_el: εἰσέλθοι πᾶσα ἡ κακία αὐτῶν κατὰ πρόσωπόν σου καὶ ἐπιφύλλισον αὐτοῖς ὃν τρόπον ἐποίησαν ἐπιφυλλίδα περὶ πάντων τῶν ἁμαρτημάτων μου ὅτι πολλοὶ οἱ στεναγμοί μου καὶ ἡ καρδία μου λυπεῖται

text_en: Aleph. How has the Lord covered with obscurity the daughter of Sion in his wrath ! how has he cast down from heaven to the earth the glorious one of Israel , and has not remembered his footstool in the day of his anger .
text_la: Aleph. Quomodo obtexit caligine in furore suo Dominus filiam Sion; projecit de cælo in terram inclytam Israël, et non est recordatus scabelli pedum suorum in die furoris sui!
text_el: πῶς ἐγνόφωσεν ἐν ὀργῇ αὐτοῦ κύριος τὴν θυγατέρα Σιων κατέρριψεν ἐξ οὐρανοῦ εἰς γῆν δόξασμα Ισραηλ καὶ οὐκ ἐμνήσθη ὑποποδίου ποδῶν αὐτοῦ ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ὀργῆς αὐτοῦ

text_en: Beth. The Lord has cast down headlong, and has not spared, all that was beautiful in Jacob : he has destroyed in his wrath the strong holds of the virgin of Juda , and brought them down to the ground: he has made the kingdom unclean , and the princes thereof.
text_la: Beth. Præcipitavit Dominus, nec pepercit omnia speciosa Jacob : destruxit in furore suo munitiones virginis Juda, et dejecit in terram; polluit regnum et principes ejus.
text_el: κατεπόντισεν κύριος οὐ φεισάμενος πάντα τὰ ὡραῖα Ιακωβ καθεῖλεν ἐν θυμῷ αὐτοῦ τὰ ὀχυρώματα τῆς θυγατρὸς Ιουδα ἐκόλλησεν εἰς τὴν γῆν ἐβεβήλωσεν βασιλέα αὐτῆς καὶ ἄρχοντας αὐτῆς

text_en: Ghimel. He has broken in his fierce anger all the horn of Israel : he has drawn back his right hand from before the enemy: and he has kindled in Jacob as it were a flaming fire devouring round about.
text_la: Ghimel. Confregit in ira furoris sui omne cornu Israël; avertit retrorsum dexteram suam a facie inimici, et succendit in Jacob quasi ignem flammæ devorantis in gyro.
text_el: συνέκλασεν ἐν ὀργῇ θυμοῦ αὐτοῦ πᾶν κέρας Ισραηλ ἀπέστρεψεν ὀπίσω δεξιὰν αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ προσώπου ἐχθροῦ καὶ ἀνῆψεν ἐν Ιακωβ ὡς πῦρ φλόγα καὶ κατέφαγεν πάντα τὰ κύκλῳ

text_en: Daleth. He has bent his bow as an enemy, he has fixed his right hand as an adversary: and he has killed all that was fair to behold in the tabernacle of the daughter of Sion, he has poured out his indignation like fire.
text_la: Daleth. Tetendit arcum suum quasi inimicus, firmavit dexteram suam quasi hostis, et occidit omne quod pulchrum erat visu in tabernaculo filiæ Sion; effudit quasi ignem indignationem suam.
text_el: ἐνέτεινεν τόξον αὐτοῦ ὡς ἐχθρός ἐστερέωσεν δεξιὰν αὐτοῦ ὡς ὑπεναντίος καὶ ἀπέκτεινεν πάντα τὰ ἐπιθυμήματα ὀφθαλμῶν μου ἐν σκηνῇ θυγατρὸς Σιων ἐξέχεεν ὡς πῦρ τὸν θυμὸν αὐτοῦ

text_en: He. The Lord has become as an enemy: he has cast down Israel headlong, he has overthrown all the walls thereof: he has destroyed his strong holds, and has multiplied in the daughter of Juda the afflicted, both men and women .
text_la: He. Factus est Dominus velut inimicus, præcipitavit Israël : præcipitavit omnia mœnia ejus, dissipavit munitiones ejus, et replevit in filia Juda humiliatum et humiliatam.
text_el: ἐγενήθη κύριος ὡς ἐχθρός κατεπόντισεν Ισραηλ κατεπόντισεν πάσας τὰς βάρεις αὐτῆς διέφθειρεν τὰ ὀχυρώματα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπλήθυνεν τῇ θυγατρὶ Ιουδα ταπεινουμένην καὶ τεταπεινωμένην

text_en: Vau. And he has destroyed his tent as a garden, he has thrown down his tabernacle: the Lord has caused feasts and sabbaths to be forgotten in Sion: and has delivered up king and priest to reproach, and to the indignation of his wrath .
text_la: Vau. Et dissipavit quasi hortum tentorium suum; demolitus est tabernaculum suum. Oblivioni tradidit Dominus in Sion festivitatem et sabbatum; et in opprobrium, et in indignationem furoris sui, regem et sacerdotem.
text_el: καὶ διεπέτασεν ὡς ἄμπελον τὸ σκήνωμα αὐτοῦ διέφθειρεν ἑορτὴν αὐτοῦ ἐπελάθετο κύριος ὃ ἐποίησεν ἐν Σιων ἑορτῆς καὶ σαββάτου καὶ παρώξυνεν ἐμβριμήματι ὀργῆς αὐτοῦ βασιλέα καὶ ἱερέα καὶ ἄρχοντα

text_en: Zain. The Lord has cast off his altar , he has cursed his sanctuary: he has delivered the walls of the towers thereof into the hand of the enemy: they have made a noise in the house of the Lord , as in the day of a solemn feast.
text_la: Zain. Repulit Dominus altare suum; maledixit sanctificationi suæ : tradidit in manu inimici muros turrium ejus. Vocem dederunt in domo Domini sicut in die solemni.
text_el: ἀπώσατο κύριος θυσιαστήριον αὐτοῦ ἀπετίναξεν ἁγίασμα αὐτοῦ συνέτριψεν ἐν χειρὶ ἐχθροῦ τεῖχος βάρεων αὐτῆς φωνὴν ἔδωκαν ἐν οἴκῳ κυρίου ὡς ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ἑορτῆς

text_en: Heth. The Lord has purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Sion: he has stretched out his line, and has not withdrawn his hand from destroying: and the bulwark has mourned, and the wall has been destroyed together.
text_la: Heth. Cogitavit Dominus dissipare murum filiæ Sion; tetendit funiculum suum, et non avertit manum suam a perditione : luxitque antemurale, et murus pariter dissipatus est.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέστρεψεν κύριος τοῦ διαφθεῖραι τεῖχος θυγατρὸς Σιων ἐξέτεινεν μέτρον οὐκ ἀπέστρεψεν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ καταπατήματος καὶ ἐπένθησεν τὸ προτείχισμα καὶ τεῖχος ὁμοθυμαδὸν ἠσθένησεν

text_en: Teth. Her gates are sunk into the ground: he has destroyed, and broken her bars: her king and her princes are among the Gentiles : the law is no more, and her prophets have found no vision from the Lord .
text_la: Teth. Defixæ sunt in terra portæ ejus, perdidit et contrivit vectes ejus; regem ejus et principes ejus in gentibus : non est lex, et prophetæ ejus non invenerunt visionem a Domino.
text_el: ἐνεπάγησαν εἰς γῆν πύλαι αὐτῆς ἀπώλεσεν καὶ συνέτριψεν μοχλοὺς αὐτῆς βασιλέα αὐτῆς καὶ ἄρχοντας αὐτῆς ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν οὐκ ἔστιν νόμος καί γε προφῆται αὐτῆς οὐκ εἶδον ὅρασιν παρὰ κυρίου

text_en: Jod. The ancients of the daughter of Sion sit upon the ground, they have held their peace: they have sprinkled their heads with dust, they are girded with haircloth, the virgins of Jerusalem hang down their heads to the ground.
text_la: Jod. Sederunt in terra, conticuerunt senes filiæ Sion; consperserunt cinere capita sua, accincti sunt ciliciis : abjecerunt in terram capita sua virgines Jerusalem.
text_el: ἐκάθισαν εἰς τὴν γῆν ἐσιώπησαν πρεσβύτεροι θυγατρὸς Σιων ἀνεβίβασαν χοῦν ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν αὐτῶν περιεζώσαντο σάκκους κατήγαγον εἰς γῆν ἀρχηγοὺς παρθένους ἐν Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: Caph. My eyes have failed with weeping, my bowels are troubled: my liver is poured out upon the earth, for the destruction of the daughter of my people, when the children, and the sucklings, fainted away in the streets of the city.
text_la: Caph. Defecerunt præ lacrimis oculi mei, conturbata sunt viscera mea; effusum est in terra jecur meum super contritione filiæ populi mei, cum deficeret parvulus et lactens in plateis oppidi.
text_el: ἐξέλιπον ἐν δάκρυσιν οἱ ὀφθαλμοί μου ἐταράχθη ἡ καρδία μου ἐξεχύθη εἰς γῆν ἡ δόξα μου ἐπὶ τὸ σύντριμμα τῆς θυγατρὸς τοῦ λαοῦ μου ἐν τῷ ἐκλιπεῖν νήπιον καὶ θηλάζοντα ἐν πλατείαις πόλεως

text_en: Lamed. They said to their mothers: Where is corn and wine? When they fainted away as the wounded in the streets of the city: when they breathed out their souls in the bosoms of their mothers.
text_la: Lamed. Matribus suis dixerunt : Ubi est triticum et vinum? cum deficerent quasi vulnerati in plateis civitatis, cum exhalarent animas suas in sinu matrum suarum.
text_el: ταῖς μητράσιν αὐτῶν εἶπαν ποῦ σῖτος καὶ οἶνος ἐν τῷ ἐκλύεσθαι αὐτοὺς ὡς τραυματίας ἐν πλατείαις πόλεως ἐν τῷ ἐκχεῖσθαι ψυχὰς αὐτῶν εἰς κόλπον μητέρων αὐτῶν

text_en: Mem. To what shall I compare you? Or to what shall I liken you, O daughter of Jerusalem ? To what shall I equal you, that I may comfort you, O virgin daughter of Sion? For great as the sea is your destruction: who shall heal you?
text_la: Mem. Cui comparabo te, vel cui assimilabo te, filia Jerusalem? cui exæquabo te, et consolabor te, virgo, filia Sion? magna est enim velut mare contritio tua : quis medebitur tui?
text_el: τί μαρτυρήσω σοι ἢ τί ὁμοιώσω σοι θύγατερ Ιερουσαλημ τίς σώσει σε καὶ παρακαλέσει σε παρθένος θύγατερ Σιων ὅτι ἐμεγαλύνθη ποτήριον συντριβῆς σου τίς ἰάσεταί σε

text_en: Nun. Your prophets have seen false and foolish things for you: and they have not laid open your iniquity , to excite you to penance : but they have seen for you false revelations and banishments.
text_la: Nun. Prophetæ tui viderunt tibi falsa et stulta; nec aperiebant iniquitatem tuam, ut te ad pœnitentiam provocarent; viderunt autem tibi assumptiones falsas, et ejectiones.
text_el: προφῆταί σου εἴδοσάν σοι μάταια καὶ ἀφροσύνην καὶ οὐκ ἀπεκάλυψαν ἐπὶ τὴν ἀδικίαν σου τοῦ ἐπιστρέψαι αἰχμαλωσίαν σου καὶ εἴδοσάν σοι λήμματα μάταια καὶ ἐξώσματα

text_en: Samech. All they that passed by the way have clapped their hands at you: they have hissed, and wagged their heads at the daughter of Jerusalem , saying: Is this the city of perfect beauty, the joy of all the earth?
text_la: Samech. Plauserunt super te manibus omnes transeuntes per viam; sibilaverunt et moverunt caput suum super filiam Jerusalem : Hæccine est urbs, dicentes, perfecti decoris, gaudium universæ terræ?
text_el: ἐκρότησαν ἐπὶ σὲ χεῖρας πάντες οἱ παραπορευόμενοι ὁδόν ἐσύρισαν καὶ ἐκίνησαν τὴν κεφαλὴν αὐτῶν ἐπὶ τὴν θυγατέρα Ιερουσαλημ ἦ αὕτη ἡ πόλις ἣν ἐροῦσιν στέφανος δόξης εὐφροσύνη πάσης τῆς γῆς

text_en: Phe. All your enemies have opened their month against you: they have hissed, and gnashed with the teeth, and have said: We will swallow her up: lo, this is the day which we looked for: we have found it, we have seen it.
text_la: Phe. Aperuerunt super te os suum omnes inimici tui : sibilaverunt, et fremuerunt dentibus, et dixerunt : Devorabimus : en ista est dies quam exspectabamus; invenimus, vidimus.
text_el: διήνοιξαν ἐπὶ σὲ στόμα αὐτῶν πάντες οἱ ἐχθροί σου ἐσύρισαν καὶ ἔβρυξαν ὀδόντας εἶπαν κατεπίομεν αὐτήν πλὴν αὕτη ἡ ἡμέρα ἣν προσεδοκῶμεν εὕρομεν αὐτήν εἴδομεν

text_en: Ain. The Lord has done that which he purposed, he has fulfilled his word, which he commanded in the days of old: he has destroyed, and has not spared, and he has caused the enemy to rejoice over you, and has set up the horn of your adversaries.
text_la: Ain. Fecit Dominus quæ cogitavit; complevit sermonem suum, quem præceperat a diebus antiquis : destruxit, et non pepercit, et lætificavit super te inimicum, et exaltavit cornu hostium tuorum.
text_el: ἐποίησεν κύριος ἃ ἐνεθυμήθη συνετέλεσεν ῥήματα αὐτοῦ ἃ ἐνετείλατο ἐξ ἡμερῶν ἀρχαίων καθεῖλεν καὶ οὐκ ἐφείσατο καὶ ηὔφρανεν ἐπὶ σὲ ἐχθρόν ὕψωσεν κέρας θλίβοντός σε

text_en: Sade. Their heart cried to the Lord upon the walls of the daughter of Sion: Let tears run down like a torrent day and night: give yourself no rest, and let not the apple of your eye cease.
text_la: Sade. Clamavit cor eorum ad Dominum super muros filiæ Sion : Deduc quasi torrentem lacrimas per diem et noctem; non des requiem tibi, neque taceat pupilla oculi tui.
text_el: ἐβόησεν καρδία αὐτῶν πρὸς κύριον τείχη Σιων καταγάγετε ὡς χειμάρρους δάκρυα ἡμέρας καὶ νυκτός μὴ δῷς ἔκνηψιν σεαυτῇ μὴ σιωπήσαιτο θύγατερ ὁ ὀφθαλμός σου

text_en: Coph. Arise, give praise in the night, in the beginning of the watches: pour out your heart like water, before the face of the Lord : lift up your hands to him for the life of your little children, that have fainted for hunger at the top of all the streets.
text_la: Coph. Consurge, lauda in nocte, in principio vigiliarum; effunde sicut aquam cor tuum ante conspectum Domini : leva ad eum manus tuas pro anima parvulorum tuorum, qui defecerunt in fame in capite omnium compitorum.
text_el: ἀνάστα ἀγαλλίασαι ἐν νυκτὶ εἰς ἀρχὰς φυλακῆς σου ἔκχεον ὡς ὕδωρ καρδίαν σου ἀπέναντι προσώπου κυρίου ἆρον πρὸς αὐτὸν χεῖράς σου περὶ ψυχῆς νηπίων σου τῶν ἐκλυομένων λιμῷ ἐπ' ἀρχῆς πασῶν ἐξόδων

text_en: Res. Behold, O Lord , and consider whom you have thus dealt with: shall women then eat their own fruit, their children of a span long? Shall the priest and the prophet be slain in the sanctuary of the Lord ?
text_la: Res. Vide, Domine, et considera quem vindemiaveris ita. Ergone comedent mulieres fructum suum, parvulos ad mensuram palmæ? si occiditur in sanctuario Domini sacerdos et propheta?
text_el: ἰδέ κύριε καὶ ἐπίβλεψον τίνι ἐπεφύλλισας οὕτως εἰ φάγονται γυναῖκες καρπὸν κοιλίας αὐτῶν ἐπιφυλλίδα ἐποίησεν μάγειρος φονευθήσονται νήπια θηλάζοντα μαστούς ἀποκτενεῖς ἐν ἁγιάσματι κυρίου ἱερέα καὶ προφήτην

text_en: Sin. The child and the old man lie without on the ground: my virgins and my young men are fallen by the sword: you have slain them in the day of your wrath : you have killed, and shown them no pity.
text_la: Sin. Jacuerunt in terra foris puer et senex; virgines meæ et juvenes mei ceciderunt in gladio : interfecisti in die furoris tui, percussisti, nec misertus es.
text_el: ἐκοιμήθησαν εἰς τὴν ἔξοδον παιδάριον καὶ πρεσβύτης παρθένοι μου καὶ νεανίσκοι μου ἐπορεύθησαν ἐν αἰχμαλωσίᾳ ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ καὶ ἐν λιμῷ ἀπέκτεινας ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ὀργῆς σου ἐμαγείρευσας οὐκ ἐφείσω

text_en: Thau. You have called as to a festival, those that should terrify me round about, and there was none in the day of the wrath of the Lord that escaped and was left: those that I brought up, and nourished, my enemy has consumed them.
text_la: Thau. Vocasti quasi ad diem solemnem, qui terrerent me de circuitu; et non fuit in die furoris Domini qui effugeret, et relinqueretur : quos educavi et enutrivi, inimicus meus consumpsit eos.
text_el: ἐκάλεσεν ἡμέραν ἑορτῆς παροικίας μου κυκλόθεν καὶ οὐκ ἐγένοντο ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ὀργῆς κυρίου ἀνασῳζόμενος καὶ καταλελειμμένος ὡς ἐπεκράτησα καὶ ἐπλήθυνα ἐχθρούς μου πάντας

text_en: Aleph. I am the man that see my poverty by the rod of his indignation.
text_la: Aleph. Ego vir videns paupertatem meam in virga indignationis ejus.
text_el: ἐγὼ ἀνὴρ ὁ βλέπων πτωχείαν ἐν ῥάβδῳ θυμοῦ αὐτοῦ ἐπ' ἐμέ

text_en: Aleph. He has led me, and brought me into darkness, and not into light.
text_la: Aleph. Me minavit, et adduxit in tenebras, et non in lucem.
text_el: παρέλαβέν με καὶ ἀπήγαγεν εἰς σκότος καὶ οὐ φῶς

text_en: Aleph. Only against me he has turned, and turned again his hand all the day.
text_la: Aleph. Tantum in me vertit et convertit manum suam tota die.
text_el: πλὴν ἐν ἐμοὶ ἐπέστρεψεν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν

text_en: Beth. My skin and my flesh he has made old, he has broken my bones.
text_la: Beth. Vetustam fecit pellem meam et carnem meam; contrivit ossa mea.
text_el: ἐπαλαίωσεν σάρκας μου καὶ δέρμα μου ὀστέα μου συνέτριψεν

text_en: Beth. He has built round about me, and he has compassed me with gall, and labour.
text_la: Beth. Ædificavit in gyro meo, et circumdedit me felle et labore.
text_el: ἀνῳκοδόμησεν κατ' ἐμοῦ καὶ ἐκύκλωσεν κεφαλήν μου καὶ ἐμόχθησεν

text_en: Beth. He has set me in dark places as those that are dead for ever.
text_la: Beth. In tenebrosis collocavit me, quasi mortuos sempiternos.
text_el: ἐν σκοτεινοῖς ἐκάθισέν με ὡς νεκροὺς αἰῶνος

text_en: Ghimel. He has built against me round about, that I may not get out: he has made my fetters heavy.
text_la: Ghimel. Circumædificavit adversum me, ut non egrediar; aggravavit compedem meum.
text_el: ἀνῳκοδόμησεν κατ' ἐμοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἐξελεύσομαι ἐβάρυνεν χαλκόν μου

text_en: Ghimel. Yea, and when I cry, and entreat, he has shut out my prayer .
text_la: Ghimel. Sed et cum clamavero, et rogavero, exclusit orationem meam.
text_el: καί γε κεκράξομαι καὶ βοήσω ἀπέφραξεν προσευχήν μου

text_en: Ghimel. He has shut up my ways with square stones, he has turned my paths upside down.
text_la: Ghimel. Conclusit vias meas lapidibus quadris; semitas meas subvertit.
text_el: ἀνῳκοδόμησεν ὁδούς μου ἐνέφραξεν τρίβους μου ἐτάραξεν

text_en: Daleth. He has become to me as a bear lying in wait: as a lion in secret places.
text_la: Daleth. Ursus insidians factus est mihi, leo in absconditis.
text_el: ἄρκος ἐνεδρεύουσα αὐτός μοι λέων ἐν κρυφαίοις

text_en: Daleth. He has turned aside my paths, and has broken me in pieces, he has made me desolate.
text_la: Daleth. Semitas meas subvertit, et confregit me; posuit me desolatam.
text_el: κατεδίωξεν ἀφεστηκότα καὶ κατέπαυσέν με ἔθετό με ἠφανισμένην

text_en: Daleth. He has bent his bow, and set me as a mark for his arrows.
text_la: Daleth. Tetendit arcum suum, et posuit me quasi signum ad sagittam.
text_el: ἐνέτεινεν τόξον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐστήλωσέν με ὡς σκοπὸν εἰς βέλος

text_en: He. He has shot into my reins the daughters of his quiver.
text_la: He. Misit in renibus meis filias pharetræ suæ.
text_el: εἰσήγαγεν τοῖς νεφροῖς μου ἰοὺς φαρέτρας αὐτοῦ

text_en: He. I am made a derision to all my people, their song all the day long.
text_la: He. Factus sum in derisum omni populo meo, canticum eorum tota die.
text_el: ἐγενήθην γέλως παντὶ λαῷ μου ψαλμὸς αὐτῶν ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν

text_en: He. He has filled me with bitterness, he has inebriated me with wormwood .
text_la: He. Replevit me amaritudinibus; inebriavit me absinthio.
text_el: ἐχόρτασέν με πικρίας ἐμέθυσέν με χολῆς

text_en: Vau. And he has broken my teeth one by one, he has fed me with ashes.
text_la: Vau. Et fregit ad numerum dentes meos; cibavit me cinere.
text_el: καὶ ἐξέβαλεν ψήφῳ ὀδόντας μου ἐψώμισέν με σποδόν

text_en: Vau. And my soul is removed far off from peace, I have forgotten good things.
text_la: Vau. Et repulsa est a pace anima mea; oblitus sum bonorum.
text_el: καὶ ἀπώσατο ἐξ εἰρήνης ψυχήν μου ἐπελαθόμην ἀγαθὰ

text_en: Vau. And I said: My end and my hope is perished from the Lord .
text_la: Vau. Et dixi : Periit finis meus, et spes mea a Domino.
text_el: καὶ εἶπα ἀπώλετο νεῖκός μου καὶ ἡ ἐλπίς μου ἀπὸ κυρίου

text_en: Zain. Remember my poverty, and transgression, the wormwood and the gall.
text_la: Zain. Recordare paupertatis, et transgressionis meæ, absinthii et fellis.
text_el: ἐμνήσθην ἀπὸ πτωχείας μου καὶ ἐκ διωγμοῦ μου πικρίας καὶ χολῆς μου

text_en: Zain. I will be mindful and remember, and my soul shall languish within me.
text_la: Zain. Memoria memor ero, et tabescet in me anima mea.
text_el: μνησθήσεται καὶ καταδολεσχήσει ἐπ' ἐμὲ ἡ ψυχή μου

text_en: Zain. These things I shall think over in my heart, therefore will I hope .
text_la: Zain. Hæc recolens in corde meo, ideo sperabo.
text_el: ταύτην τάξω εἰς τὴν καρδίαν μου διὰ τοῦτο ὑπομενῶ

text_en: Heth. The mercies of the Lord that we are not consumed: because his commiserations have not failed.
text_la: Heth. Misericordiæ Domini, quia non sumus consumpti; quia non defecerunt miserationes ejus.

text_en: Heth. They are new every morning, great is your faithfulness.
text_la: Heth. Novi diluculo, multa est fides tua.

text_en: Heth. The Lord is my portion, said my soul : therefore will I wait for him.
text_la: Heth. Pars mea Dominus, dixit anima mea; propterea exspectabo eum.

text_en: Teth. The Lord is good to them that hope in him, to the soul that seeks him.
text_la: Teth. Bonus est Dominus sperantibus in eum, animæ quærenti illum.
text_el: ἀγαθὸς κύριος τοῖς ὑπομένουσιν αὐτόν ψυχῇ ἣ ζητήσει αὐτὸν ἀγαθὸν

text_en: Teth. It is good to wait with silence for the salvation of God .
text_la: Teth. Bonum est præstolari cum silentio salutare Dei.
text_el: καὶ ὑπομενεῖ καὶ ἡσυχάσει εἰς τὸ σωτήριον κυρίου

text_en: Teth. It is good for a man , when he has borne the yoke from his youth.
text_la: Teth. Bonum est viro cum portaverit jugum ab adolescentia sua.
text_el: ἀγαθὸν ἀνδρὶ ὅταν ἄρῃ ζυγὸν ἐν νεότητι αὐτοῦ

text_en: Jod. He shall sit solitary, and hold his peace: because he has taken it up upon himself.
text_la: Jod. Sedebit solitarius, et tacebit, quia levavit super se.
text_el: καθήσεται κατὰ μόνας καὶ σιωπήσεται ὅτι ἦρεν ἐφ' ἑαυτῷ

text_en: Jod. He shall put his mouth in the dust, if so be there may be hope .
text_la: Jod. Ponet in pulvere os suum, si forte sit spes.

text_en: Jod. He shall give his cheek to him that strikes him, he shall be filled with reproaches.
text_la: Jod. Dabit percutienti se maxillam : saturabitur opprobriis.
text_el: δώσει τῷ παίοντι αὐτὸν σιαγόνα χορτασθήσεται ὀνειδισμῶν

text_en: Caph. For the Lord will not cast off for ever.
text_la: Caph. Quia non repellet in sempiternum Dominus.
text_el: ὅτι οὐκ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ἀπώσεται κύριος

text_en: Caph. For if he has cast off, he will also have mercy, according to the multitude of his mercies.
text_la: Caph. Quia si abjecit, et miserebitur, secundum multitudinem misericordiarum suarum.
text_el: ὅτι ὁ ταπεινώσας οἰκτιρήσει κατὰ τὸ πλῆθος τοῦ ἐλέους αὐτοῦ

text_en: Caph. For he has not willingly afflicted, nor cast off the children of men .
text_la: Caph. Non enim humiliavit ex corde suo et abjecit filios hominum.
text_el: ὅτι οὐκ ἀπεκρίθη ἀπὸ καρδίας αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐταπείνωσεν υἱοὺς ἀνδρός

text_en: Lamed. To crush under his feet all the prisoners of the land,
text_la: Lamed. Ut conteret sub pedibus suis omnes vinctos terræ.
text_el: τοῦ ταπεινῶσαι ὑπὸ τοὺς πόδας αὐτοῦ πάντας δεσμίους γῆς

text_en: Lamed. To turn aside the judgment of a man before the face of the most High ,
text_la: Lamed. Ut declinaret judicium viri in conspectu vultus Altissimi.
text_el: τοῦ ἐκκλῖναι κρίσιν ἀνδρὸς κατέναντι προσώπου ὑψίστου

text_en: Lamed. To destroy a man wrongfully in his judgment, the Lord has not approved.
text_la: Lamed. Ut perverteret hominem in judicio suo; Dominus ignoravit.
text_el: καταδικάσαι ἄνθρωπον ἐν τῷ κρίνεσθαι αὐτὸν κύριος οὐκ εἶπεν

text_en: Mem. Who is he that has commanded a thing to be done, when the Lord commands it not?
text_la: Mem. Quis est iste qui dixit ut fieret, Domino non jubente?
text_el: τίς οὕτως εἶπεν καὶ ἐγενήθη κύριος οὐκ ἐνετείλατο

text_en: Mem. Shall not both evil and good proceed out of the mouth of the Highest?
text_la: Mem. Ex ore Altissimi non egredientur nec mala nec bona?
text_el: ἐκ στόματος ὑψίστου οὐκ ἐξελεύσεται τὰ κακὰ καὶ τὸ ἀγαθόν

text_en: Mem. Why has a living man murmured, man suffering for his sins ?
text_la: Mem. Quid murmuravit homo vivens, vir pro peccatis suis?
text_el: τί γογγύσει ἄνθρωπος ζῶν ἀνὴρ περὶ τῆς ἁμαρτίας αὐτοῦ

text_en: Nun. Let us search our ways, and seek, and return to the Lord .
text_la: Nun. Scrutemur vias nostras, et quæramus, et revertamur ad Dominum.
text_el: ἐξηρευνήθη ἡ ὁδὸς ἡμῶν καὶ ἠτάσθη καὶ ἐπιστρέψωμεν ἕως κυρίου

text_en: Nun. Let us lift up our hearts with our hands to the Lord in the heavens .
text_la: Nun. Levemus corda nostra cum manibus ad Dominum in cælos.
text_el: ἀναλάβωμεν καρδίας ἡμῶν ἐπὶ χειρῶν πρὸς ὑψηλὸν ἐν οὐρανῷ

text_en: Nun. We have done wickedly , and provoked you to wrath : therefore you are inexorable.
text_la: Nun. Nos inique egimus, et ad iracundiam provocavimus; idcirco tu inexorabilis es.
text_el: ἡμαρτήσαμεν ἠσεβήσαμεν καὶ οὐχ ἱλάσθης

text_en: Samech. You have covered in your wrath , and have struck us: you have killed and have not spared.
text_la: Samech. Operuisti in furore, et percussisti nos; occidisti, nec pepercisti.
text_el: ἐπεσκέπασας ἐν θυμῷ καὶ ἀπεδίωξας ἡμᾶς ἀπέκτεινας οὐκ ἐφείσω

text_en: Samech. You have set a cloud before you, that our prayer may not pass through.
text_la: Samech. Opposuisti nubem tibi, ne transeat oratio.
text_el: ἐπεσκέπασας νεφέλην σεαυτῷ εἵνεκεν προσευχῆς

text_en: Samech. You have made me as an outcast, and refuse in the midst of the people.
text_la: Samech. Eradicationem et abjectionem posuisti me in medio populorum.
text_el: καμμύσαι με καὶ ἀπωσθῆναι ἔθηκας ἡμᾶς ἐν μέσῳ τῶν λαῶν

text_en: Phe. All our enemies have opened their mouths against us.
text_la: Phe. Aperuerunt super nos os suum omnes inimici.
text_el: διήνοιξαν ἐφ' ἡμᾶς τὸ στόμα αὐτῶν πάντες οἱ ἐχθροὶ ἡμῶν

text_en: Phe. Prophecy has become to us a fear, and a snare, and destruction.
text_la: Phe. Formido et laqueus facta est nobis vaticinatio, et contritio.
text_el: φόβος καὶ θυμὸς ἐγενήθη ἡμῖν ἔπαρσις καὶ συντριβή

text_en: Phe. My eye has run down with streams of water, for the destruction of the daughter of my people.
text_la: Phe. Divisiones aquarum deduxit oculus meus, in contritione filiæ populi mei.
text_el: ἀφέσεις ὑδάτων κατάξει ὁ ὀφθαλμός μου ἐπὶ τὸ σύντριμμα τῆς θυγατρὸς τοῦ λαοῦ μου

text_en: Ain. My eye is afflicted, and has not been quiet, because there was no rest:
text_la: Ain. Oculus meus afflictus est, nec tacuit, eo quod non esset requies.
text_el: ὁ ὀφθαλμός μου κατεπόθη καὶ οὐ σιγήσομαι τοῦ μὴ εἶναι ἔκνηψιν

text_en: Ain. Till the Lord regarded and looked down from the heavens .
text_la: Ain. Donec respiceret et videret Dominus de cælis.
text_el: ἕως οὗ διακύψῃ καὶ ἴδῃ κύριος ἐξ οὐρανοῦ

text_en: Ain. My eye has wasted my soul because of all the daughters of my city.
text_la: Ain. Oculus meus deprædatus est animam meam in cunctis filiabus urbis meæ.
text_el: ὁ ὀφθαλμός μου ἐπιφυλλιεῖ ἐπὶ τὴν ψυχήν μου παρὰ πάσας θυγατέρας πόλεως

text_en: Sade. My enemies have chased me and caught me like a bird, without cause.
text_la: Sade. Venatione ceperunt me quasi avem inimici mei gratis.
text_el: θηρεύοντες ἐθήρευσάν με ὡς στρουθίον οἱ ἐχθροί μου δωρεάν

text_en: Sade. My life is fallen into the pit, and they have laid a stone over me.
text_la: Sade. Lapsa est in lacum vita mea, et posuerunt lapidem super me.
text_el: ἐθανάτωσαν ἐν λάκκῳ ζωήν μου καὶ ἐπέθηκαν λίθον ἐπ' ἐμοί

text_en: Sade. Waters have flowed over my head: I said: I am cut off.
text_la: Sade. Inundaverunt aquæ super caput meum; dixi : Perii.
text_el: ὑπερεχύθη ὕδωρ ἐπὶ κεφαλήν μου εἶπα ἀπῶσμαι

text_en: Coph. I have called upon your name , O Lord , from the lowest pit.
text_la: Coph. Invocavi nomen tuum, Domine, de lacu novissimo.
text_el: ἐπεκαλεσάμην τὸ ὄνομά σου κύριε ἐκ λάκκου κατωτάτου

text_en: Coph. You have heard my voice: turn not away your ear from my sighs, and cries.
text_la: Coph. Vocem meam audisti; ne avertas aurem tuam a singultu meo et clamoribus.
text_el: φωνήν μου ἤκουσας μὴ κρύψῃς τὰ ὦτά σου εἰς τὴν δέησίν μου

text_en: Coph. You drew near in the day, when I called upon you, you said: Fear not.
text_la: Coph. Appropinquasti in die quando invocavi te; dixisti : Ne timeas.
text_el: εἰς τὴν βοήθειάν μου ἤγγισας ἐν ᾗ σε ἡμέρᾳ ἐπεκαλεσάμην εἶπάς μοι μὴ φοβοῦ

text_en: Res. You have judged, O Lord , the cause of my soul , you the Redeemer of my life.
text_la: Res. Judicasti, Domine, causam animæ meæ, redemptor vitæ meæ.
text_el: ἐδίκασας κύριε τὰς δίκας τῆς ψυχῆς μου ἐλυτρώσω τὴν ζωήν μου

text_en: Res. You have seen, O Lord , their iniquity against me: judge my judgment.
text_la: Res. Vidisti, Domine, iniquitatem illorum adversum me : judica judicium meum.
text_el: εἶδες κύριε τὰς ταραχάς μου ἔκρινας τὴν κρίσιν μου

text_en: Res. You have seen all their fury, and all their thoughts against me.
text_la: Res. Vidisti omnem furorem, universas cogitationes eorum adversum me.
text_el: εἶδες πᾶσαν τὴν ἐκδίκησιν αὐτῶν εἰς πάντας διαλογισμοὺς αὐτῶν ἐν ἐμοί

text_en: Sin. You have heard their reproach, O Lord , all their imaginations against me.
text_la: Sin. Audisti opprobrium eorum, Domine, omnes cogitationes eorum adversum me.
text_el: ἤκουσας τὸν ὀνειδισμὸν αὐτῶν πάντας τοὺς διαλογισμοὺς αὐτῶν κατ' ἐμοῦ

text_en: Sin. The lips of them that rise up against me: and their devices against me all the day.
text_la: Sin. Labia insurgentium mihi, et meditationes eorum adversum me tota die.
text_el: χείλη ἐπανιστανομένων μοι καὶ μελέτας αὐτῶν κατ' ἐμοῦ ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν

text_en: Sin. Behold their sitting down, and their rising up, I am their song.
text_la: Sin. Sessionem eorum et resurrectionem eorum vide; ego sum psalmus eorum.
text_el: καθέδραν αὐτῶν καὶ ἀνάστασιν αὐτῶν ἐπίβλεψον ἐπὶ τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτῶν

text_en: Thau. You shall render them a recompense, O Lord , according to the works of their hands.
text_la: Thau. Redes eis vicem, Domine, juxta opera manuum suarum.
text_el: ἀποδώσεις αὐτοῖς ἀνταπόδομα κύριε κατὰ τὰ ἔργα τῶν χειρῶν αὐτῶν

text_en: Thau. You shall give them a buckler of heart, your labour.
text_la: Thau. Dabis eis scutum cordis, laborem tuum.
text_el: ἀποδώσεις αὐτοῖς ὑπερασπισμὸν καρδίας μόχθον σου αὐτοῖς

text_en: Thau. You shall persecute them in anger , and shall destroy them from under the heavens , O Lord .
text_la: Thau. Persequeris in furore, et conteres eos sub cælis, Domine.
text_el: καταδιώξεις ἐν ὀργῇ καὶ ἐξαναλώσεις αὐτοὺς ὑποκάτω τοῦ οὐρανοῦ κύριε

text_en: Aleph. How is the gold become dim, the finest colour is changed, the stones of the sanctuary are scattered in the top of every street?
text_la: Aleph. Quomodo obscuratum est aurum, mutatus est color optimus! dispersi sunt lapides sanctuarii in capite omnium platearum!
text_el: πῶς ἀμαυρωθήσεται χρυσίον ἀλλοιωθήσεται τὸ ἀργύριον τὸ ἀγαθόν ἐξεχύθησαν λίθοι ἅγιοι ἐπ' ἀρχῆς πασῶν ἐξόδων

text_en: Beth. The noble sons of Sion, and they that were clothed with the best gold: how are they esteemed as earthen vessels, the work of the potter's hands?
text_la: Beth. Filii Sion inclyti, et amicti auro primo : quomodo reputati sunt in vasa testea, opus manuum figuli!
text_el: υἱοὶ Σιων οἱ τίμιοι οἱ ἐπηρμένοι ἐν χρυσίῳ πῶς ἐλογίσθησαν εἰς ἀγγεῖα ὀστράκινα ἔργα χειρῶν κεραμέως

text_en: Ghimel. Even the sea monsters have drawn out the breast, they have given suck to their young: the daughter of my people is cruel, like the ostrich in the desert .
text_la: Ghimel. Sed et lamiæ nudaverunt mammam, lactaverunt catulos suos : filia populi mei crudelis quasi struthio in deserto.
text_el: καί γε δράκοντες ἐξέδυσαν μαστούς ἐθήλασαν σκύμνοι αὐτῶν θυγατέρες λαοῦ μου εἰς ἀνίατον ὡς στρουθίον ἐν ἐρήμῳ

text_en: Daleth. The tongue of the sucking child has stuck to the roof of his mouth for thirst: the little ones have asked for bread, and there was none to break it unto them.
text_la: Daleth. Adhæsit lingua lactentis ad palatum ejus in siti; parvuli petierunt panem, et non erat qui frangeret eis.
text_el: ἐκολλήθη ἡ γλῶσσα θηλάζοντος πρὸς τὸν φάρυγγα αὐτοῦ ἐν δίψει νήπια ᾔτησαν ἄρτον ὁ διακλῶν οὐκ ἔστιν αὐτοῖς

text_en: He. They that were fed delicately have died in the streets: they that were brought up in scarlet have embraced the dung.
text_la: He. Qui vescebantur voluptuose, interierunt in viis; qui nutriebantur in croceis, amplexati sunt stercora.
text_el: οἱ ἔσθοντες τὰς τρυφὰς ἠφανίσθησαν ἐν ταῖς ἐξόδοις οἱ τιθηνούμενοι ἐπὶ κόκκων περιεβάλοντο κοπρίας

text_en: Vau. And the iniquity of the daughter of my people is made greater than the sin of Sodom , which was overthrown in a moment, and hands took nothing in her.
text_la: Vau. Et major effecta est iniquitas filiæ populi mei peccato Sodomorum, quæ subversa est in momento, et non ceperunt in ea manus.
text_el: καὶ ἐμεγαλύνθη ἀνομία θυγατρὸς λαοῦ μου ὑπὲρ ἀνομίας Σοδομων τῆς κατεστραμμένης ὥσπερ σπουδῇ καὶ οὐκ ἐπόνεσαν ἐν αὐτῇ χεῖρας

text_en: Zain. Her Nazarites were whiter than snow, purer than milk, more ruddy than the old ivory, fairer than the sapphire.
text_la: Zain. Candidiores Nazaræi ejus nive, nitidiores lacte, rubicundiores ebore antiquo, sapphiro pulchriores.
text_el: ἐκαθαριώθησαν ναζιραῖοι αὐτῆς ὑπὲρ χιόνα ἔλαμψαν ὑπὲρ γάλα ἐπυρρώθησαν ὑπὲρ λίθους σαπφείρου τὸ ἀπόσπασμα αὐτῶν

text_en: Heth. Their face is now made blacker than coals, and they are not known in the streets: their skin has stuck to their bones, it is withered, and has become like wood.
text_la: Heth. Denigrata est super carbones facies eorum et non sunt cogniti in plateis; adhæsit cutis eorum ossibus : aruit, et facta est quasi lignum.
text_el: ἐσκότασεν ὑπὲρ ἀσβόλην τὸ εἶδος αὐτῶν οὐκ ἐπεγνώσθησαν ἐν ταῖς ἐξόδοις ἐπάγη δέρμα αὐτῶν ἐπὶ τὰ ὀστέα αὐτῶν ἐξηράνθησαν ἐγενήθησαν ὥσπερ ξύλον

text_en: Teth. It was better with them that were slain by the sword, than with them that died with hunger: for these pined away being consumed for want of the fruits of the earth.
text_la: Teth. Melius fuit occisis gladio quam interfectis fame, quoniam isti extabuerunt consumpti a sterilitate terræ.
text_el: καλοὶ ἦσαν οἱ τραυματίαι ῥομφαίας ἢ οἱ τραυματίαι λιμοῦ ἐπορεύθησαν ἐκκεκεντημένοι ἀπὸ γενημάτων ἀγρῶν

text_en: Jod. The hands of the pitiful women have sodden their own children: they were their meat in the destruction of the daughter of my people.
text_la: Jod. Manus mulierum misericordium coxerunt filios suos; facti sunt cibus earum in contritione filiæ populi mei.
text_el: χεῖρες γυναικῶν οἰκτιρμόνων ἥψησαν τὰ παιδία αὐτῶν ἐγενήθησαν εἰς βρῶσιν αὐταῖς ἐν τῷ συντρίμματι τῆς θυγατρὸς λαοῦ μου

text_en: Caph. The Lord has accomplished his wrath , he has poured out his fierce anger : and he has kindled a fire in Sion, and it has devoured the foundations thereof.
text_la: Caph. Complevit Dominus furorem suum, effudit iram indignationis suæ : et succendit ignem in Sion, et devoravit fundamenta ejus.
text_el: συνετέλεσεν κύριος θυμὸν αὐτοῦ ἐξέχεεν θυμὸν ὀργῆς αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀνῆψεν πῦρ ἐν Σιων καὶ κατέφαγεν τὰ θεμέλια αὐτῆς

text_en: Lamed. The kings of the earth, and all the inhabitants of the world would not have believed , that the adversary and the enemy should enter in by the gates of Jerusalem .
text_la: Lamed. Non crediderunt reges terræ, et universi habitatores orbis, quoniam ingrederetur hostis et inimicus per portas Jerusalem.
text_el: οὐκ ἐπίστευσαν βασιλεῖς γῆς πάντες οἱ κατοικοῦντες τὴν οἰκουμένην ὅτι εἰσελεύσεται ἐχθρὸς καὶ ἐκθλίβων διὰ τῶν πυλῶν Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: Mem. For the sins of her prophets , and the iniquities of her priests , that have shed the blood of the just in the midst of her.
text_la: Mem. Propter peccata prophetarum ejus, et iniquitates sacerdotum ejus, qui effuderunt in medio ejus sanguinem justorum.
text_el: ἐξ ἁμαρτιῶν προφητῶν αὐτῆς ἀδικιῶν ἱερέων αὐτῆς τῶν ἐκχεόντων αἷμα δίκαιον ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῆς

text_en: Nun. They have wandered as blind men in the streets, they were defiled with blood: and when they could not help walking in it, they held up their skirts.
text_la: Nun. Erraverunt cæci in plateis, polluti sunt in sanguine; cumque non possent, tenuerunt lacinias suas.
text_el: ἐσαλεύθησαν ἐγρήγοροι αὐτῆς ἐν ταῖς ἐξόδοις ἐμολύνθησαν ἐν αἵματι ἐν τῷ μὴ δύνασθαι αὐτοὺς ἥψαντο ἐνδυμάτων αὐτῶν

text_en: Samech. Depart you that are defiled, they cried out to them: Depart, get hence, touch not: for they quarrelled, and being removed, they said among the Gentiles : He will no more dwell among them.
text_la: Samech. Recedite polluti, clamaverunt eis; recedite, abite, nolite tangere : jurgati quippe sunt, et commoti dixerunt inter gentes : Non addet ultra ut habitet in eis.
text_el: ἀπόστητε ἀκαθάρτων καλέσατε αὐτούς ἀπόστητε ἀπόστητε μὴ ἅπτεσθε ὅτι ἀνήφθησαν καί γε ἐσαλεύθησαν εἴπατε ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν οὐ μὴ προσθῶσιν τοῦ παροικεῖν

text_en: Phe. The face of the Lord has divided them, he will no more regard them: they respected not the persons of the priests , neither had they pity on the ancient.
text_la: Phe. Facies Domini divisit eos, non addet ut respiciat eos; facies sacerdotum non erubuerunt, neque senum miserti sunt.
text_el: πρόσωπον κυρίου μερὶς αὐτῶν οὐ προσθήσει ἐπιβλέψαι αὐτοῖς πρόσωπον ἱερέων οὐκ ἔλαβον πρεσβύτας οὐκ ἠλέησαν

text_en: Ain. While we were yet standing, our eyes failed, expecting help for us in vain, when we looked attentively towards a nation that was not able to save.
text_la: Ain. Cum adhuc subsisteremus, defecerunt oculi nostri ad auxilium nostrum vanum; cum respiceremus attenti ad gentem quæ salvare non poterat.
text_el: ἔτι ὄντων ἡμῶν ἐξέλιπον οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ ἡμῶν εἰς τὴν βοήθειαν ἡμῶν μάταια ἀποσκοπευόντων ἡμῶν ἀπεσκοπεύσαμεν εἰς ἔθνος οὐ σῷζον

text_en: Sade. Our steps have slipped in the way of our streets, our end draws near: our days are fulfilled, for our end has come.
text_la: Sade. Lubricaverunt vestigia nostra in itinere platearum nostrarum; appropinquavit finis noster, completi sunt dies nostri, quia venit finis noster.
text_el: ἐθηρεύσαμεν μικροὺς ἡμῶν τοῦ μὴ πορεύεσθαι ἐν ταῖς πλατείαις ἡμῶν ἤγγικεν ὁ καιρὸς ἡμῶν ἐπληρώθησαν αἱ ἡμέραι ἡμῶν πάρεστιν ὁ καιρὸς ἡμῶν

text_en: Coph. Our persecutors were swifter than the eagles of the air: they pursued us upon the mountains, they lay in wait for us in the wilderness .
text_la: Coph. Velociores fuerunt persecutores nostri aquilis cæli; super montes persecuti sunt nos, in deserto insidiati sunt nobis.
text_el: κοῦφοι ἐγένοντο οἱ διώκοντες ἡμᾶς ὑπὲρ ἀετοὺς οὐρανοῦ ἐπὶ τῶν ὀρέων ἐξήφθησαν ἐν ἐρήμῳ ἐνήδρευσαν ἡμᾶς

text_en: Res. The breath of our mouth, Christ the Lord, is taken in our sins : to whom we said: Under your shadow we shall live among the Gentiles .
text_la: Res. Spiritus oris nostri, christus Dominus, captus est in peccatis nostris, cui diximus : In umbra tua vivemus in gentibus.
text_el: πνεῦμα προσώπου ἡμῶν χριστὸς κυρίου συνελήμφθη ἐν ταῖς διαφθοραῖς αὐτῶν οὗ εἴπαμεν ἐν τῇ σκιᾷ αὐτοῦ ζησόμεθα ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν

text_en: Sin. Rejoice, and be glad, O daughter of Edom , that dwell in the land of Hus: to you also shall the cup come, you shall be made drunk, and naked.
text_la: Sin. Gaude et lætare, filia Edom, quæ habitas in terra Hus! ad te quoque perveniet calix : inebriaberis, atque nudaberis.
text_el: χαῖρε καὶ εὐφραίνου θύγατερ Ιδουμαίας ἡ κατοικοῦσα ἐπὶ γῆς καί γε ἐπὶ σὲ διελεύσεται τὸ ποτήριον κυρίου καὶ μεθυσθήσῃ καὶ ἀποχεεῖς

text_en: Thau. Your iniquity is accomplished, O daughter of Sion, he will no more carry you away into captivity: he has visited your iniquity , O daughter of Edom , he has discovered your sins .
text_la: Thau. Completa est iniquitas tua, filia Sion : non addet ultra ut transmigret te. Visitavit iniquitatem tuam, filia Edom; discooperuit peccata tua.
text_el: ἐξέλιπεν ἡ ἀνομία σου θύγατερ Σιων οὐ προσθήσει ἔτι ἀποικίσαι σε ἐπεσκέψατο ἀνομίας σου θύγατερ Εδωμ ἀπεκάλυψεν ἐπὶ τὰ ἀσεβήματά σου

text_en: Remember, O Lord , what has come upon us: consider and behold our reproach.
text_la: Recordare, Domine, quid acciderit nobis; intuere et respice opprobrium nostrum.
text_el: μνήσθητι κύριε ὅ τι ἐγενήθη ἡμῖν ἐπίβλεψον καὶ ἰδὲ τὸν ὀνειδισμὸν ἡμῶν

text_en: Our inheritance is turned to aliens: our houses to strangers.
text_la: Hæreditas nostra versa est ad alienos, domus nostræ ad extraneos.
text_el: κληρονομία ἡμῶν μετεστράφη ἀλλοτρίοις οἱ οἶκοι ἡμῶν ξένοις

text_en: We have become orphans without a father: our mothers are as widows .
text_la: Pupilli facti sumus absque patre, matres nostræ quasi viduæ.
text_el: ὀρφανοὶ ἐγενήθημεν οὐχ ὑπάρχει πατήρ μητέρες ἡμῶν ὡς αἱ χῆραι

text_en: We have drunk our water for money: we have bought our wood.
text_la: Aquam nostram pecunia bibimus; ligna nostra pretio comparavimus.
text_el: ἐξ ἡμερῶν ἡμῶν ξύλα ἡμῶν ἐν ἀλλάγματι ἦλθεν

text_en: We were dragged by the necks, we were weary and no rest was given us.
text_la: Cervicibus nostris minabamur, lassis non dabatur requies.
text_el: ἐπὶ τὸν τράχηλον ἡμῶν ἐδιώχθημεν ἐκοπιάσαμεν οὐκ ἀνεπαύθημεν

text_en: We have given our hand to Egypt , and to the Assyrians , that we might be satisfied with bread.
text_la: Ægypto dedimus manum et Assyriis, ut saturaremur pane.
text_el: Αἴγυπτος ἔδωκεν χεῖρα Ασσουρ εἰς πλησμονὴν αὐτῶν

text_en: Our fathers have sinned , and are not: and we have borne their iniquities .
text_la: Patres nostri peccaverunt, et non sunt : et nos iniquitates eorum portavimus.
text_el: οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν ἥμαρτον οὐχ ὑπάρχουσιν ἡμεῖς τὰ ἀνομήματα αὐτῶν ὑπέσχομεν

text_en: Servants have ruled over us: there was none to redeem us out of their hand.
text_la: Servi dominati sunt nostri : non fuit qui redimeret de manu eorum.
text_el: δοῦλοι ἐκυρίευσαν ἡμῶν λυτρούμενος οὐκ ἔστιν ἐκ τῆς χειρὸς αὐτῶν

text_en: We fetched our bread at the peril of our lives, because of the sword in the desert .
text_la: In animabus nostris afferebamus panem nobis, a facie gladii in deserto.
text_el: ἐν ταῖς ψυχαῖς ἡμῶν εἰσοίσομεν ἄρτον ἡμῶν ἀπὸ προσώπου ῥομφαίας τῆς ἐρήμου

text_en: Our skin was burnt as an oven, by reason of the violence of the famine.
text_la: Pellis nostra quasi clibanus exusta est, a facie tempestatum famis.
text_el: τὸ δέρμα ἡμῶν ὡς κλίβανος ἐπελειώθη συνεσπάσθησαν ἀπὸ προσώπου καταιγίδων λιμοῦ

text_en: They oppressed the women in Sion, and the virgins in the cities of Juda .
text_la: Mulieres in Sion humiliaverunt, et virgines in civitatibus Juda.
text_el: γυναῖκας ἐν Σιων ἐταπείνωσαν παρθένους ἐν πόλεσιν Ιουδα

text_en: The princes were hanged up by their hand: they did not respect the persons of the ancients.
text_la: Principes manu suspensi sunt; facies senum non erubuerunt.
text_el: ἄρχοντες ἐν χερσὶν αὐτῶν ἐκρεμάσθησαν πρεσβύτεροι οὐκ ἐδοξάσθησαν

text_en: They abused the young men indecently: and the children fell under the wood.
text_la: Adolescentibus impudice abusi sunt, et pueri in ligno corruerunt.
text_el: ἐκλεκτοὶ κλαυθμὸν ἀνέλαβον καὶ νεανίσκοι ἐν ξύλῳ ἠσθένησαν

text_en: The ancients have ceased from the gates: the young men from the choir of the singers.
text_la: Senes defecerunt de portis, juvenes de choro psallentium.
text_el: καὶ πρεσβῦται ἀπὸ πύλης κατέπαυσαν ἐκλεκτοὶ ἐκ ψαλμῶν αὐτῶν κατέπαυσαν

text_en: The joy of our heart is ceased, our dancing is turned into mourning.
text_la: Defecit gaudium cordis nostri; versus est in luctum chorus noster.
text_el: κατέλυσεν χαρὰ καρδίας ἡμῶν ἐστράφη εἰς πένθος ὁ χορὸς ἡμῶν

text_en: The crown is fallen from our head: woe to us, because we have sinned .
text_la: Cecidit corona capitis nostri : væ nobis, quia peccavimus!
text_el: ἔπεσεν ὁ στέφανος τῆς κεφαλῆς ἡμῶν οὐαὶ δὴ ἡμῖν ὅτι ἡμάρτομεν

text_en: Therefore is our heart sorrowful, therefore are our eyes become dim.
text_la: Propterea mœstum factum est cor nostrum; ideo contenebrati sunt oculi nostri,
text_el: περὶ τούτου ἐγενήθη ὀδυνηρὰ ἡ καρδία ἡμῶν περὶ τούτου ἐσκότασαν οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ ἡμῶν

text_en: For mount Sion, because it is destroyed, foxes have walked upon it.
text_la: propter montem Sion quia disperiit; vulpes ambulaverunt in eo.
text_el: ἐπ' ὄρος Σιων ὅτι ἠφανίσθη ἀλώπεκες διῆλθον ἐν αὐτῇ

text_en: But you, O Lord , shall remain for ever, your throne from generation to generation .
text_la: Tu autem, Domine, in æternum permanebis, solium tuum in generationem et generationem.
text_el: σὺ δέ κύριε εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα κατοικήσεις ὁ θρόνος σου εἰς γενεὰν καὶ γενεάν

text_en: Why will you forget us for ever? Why will you forsake us for a long time?
text_la: Quare in perpetuum oblivisceris nostri, derelinques nos in longitudine dierum?
text_el: ἵνα τί εἰς νεῖκος ἐπιλήσῃ ἡμῶν καταλείψεις ἡμᾶς εἰς μακρότητα ἡμερῶν

text_en: Convert us, O Lord , to you, and we shall be converted : renew our days, as from the beginning.
text_la: Converte nos, Domine, ad te, et convertemur; innova dies nostros, sicut a principio.
text_el: ἐπίστρεψον ἡμᾶς κύριε πρὸς σέ καὶ ἐπιστραφησόμεθα καὶ ἀνακαίνισον ἡμέρας ἡμῶν καθὼς ἔμπροσθεν

text_en: But you have utterly rejected us, you are exceedingly angry against us.
text_la: Sed projiciens repulisti nos : iratus es contra nos vehementer.
text_el: ὅτι ἀπωθούμενος ἀπώσω ἡμᾶς ὠργίσθης ἐφ' ἡμᾶς ἕως σφόδρα
